papers.title: Structured Epistemic Learning
papers.current_ceiling: Bounded real-data positives, a Wine null, a Qwen scaling negative and a causal-diagnostic result exist across main/review branches; main still lacks the canonical manuscript body.
post_matrix_updates: Commit 87e2bcb recovered invariant-margin-diagnosis theory material to main, but it did not canonically land the review-branch manuscript/PDF.
load_bearing_adverse: The manuscript directory on main is empty.
UT3 custody has only 4/6 checkpoints and zero grid cells executed.
The D-A CANNOT_CHECK and Qwen scaling negative must remain alongside any positive.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: First bind the strongest admissible evidence and manuscript on main; then test whether the causal diagnosis survives hostile same-information representation, length and format interventions across model/task families.
papers.decisive_question: Under exact same-information transformations, can the frozen invariant-margin rule distinguish inaccessible representation from missing computation better than generic compute escalation across held-out model and task families?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A transferable causal diagnostic separates information absence, access/representation failure and computation insufficiency under full resource accounting.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The diagnostic should predict the intervention that restores performance, abstain on non-identifiable cells and avoid false compute escalation across representation and model-family shifts.
papers.population_or_universe: Prospectively frozen procedural and structured tasks crossed with E16 model families and semantically equivalent representation/format interventions.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Task × model × intervention cell, with intervention-defined causal gold.
historical_only_inputs: All current V2/V3 cells and UT3 checkpoint outcomes
design: Land the canonical manuscript/evidence path-by-path before claiming readiness.
Do not execute UT3 until a frozen grid-cell executor, renderer identities and gold verifier exist.
Create same-information transformations with independently checked semantic equivalence.
Cross model families and task families with held-out interventions.
Compare diagnosis-guided intervention with generic compute, representation-only and oracle intervention policies.
baselines: Oracle intervention chosen from causal gold.
analysis_plan: Paired cell-level analysis with model/task family holdouts.
Gold is intervention-defined and independently verified.
No grid result is reported until all frozen cell executors and checkpoints are present.
Retain every positive, null, negative and CANNOT_CHECK terminal.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Power on model/task clusters and include all frozen intervention cells; minimum identifiable and non-identifiable counts are fixed before execution.
papers.success_gate: Diagnosis accuracy and downstream intervention utility beat generic compute, false compute escalation remains below the frozen bound, and abstention is correct on non-identifiable cells across held-out families.
papers.refutation_gate: Failure under same-information hostile transformations, false compute escalation or model-family collapse limits the result to the bounded datasets.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if manuscript/evidence binding is incomplete, checkpoints/renderers/gold are missing or semantic equivalence cannot be independently certified.
papers.authority_required: Independent semantic-equivalence verifier/evaluator; external model families provide transfer, not external-investigator authority by themselves.

immediate_safe_actions: Reconcile the review-branch manuscript/PDF and evidence against current main without wholesale merge.

papers.journal_bar: A top-tier causal/representation paper needs canonical evidence, factorial interventions with causal gold, model/task transfer, hostile format controls and complete resource vectors.
